instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry mixed greens and raspberries. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (5 oz) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)
3 (6 oz) pkgs raspberries

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season chicken with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, coat the bottom with oil. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken to the pan and grill, turning once, until cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup red wine vinegar
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, roughly chop pecans and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Remove chicken to a cutting board and cut into strips.
Add chicken, mixed greens, and raspberries to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, crumble goat cheese over top, and enjoy!
Preheat oven to 425°F.

Place flatbreads on a large baking sheet pan; drizzle with oil, season with spices, and sprinkle with cheese. Place flatbreads in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until crispy, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 flatbreads or naan
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp rosemary, dried
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and small dice celery. Place in a medium bowl.
Drain and rinse lentils. Add to the bowl with the celery along with mayo, dressing, and salt. Stir to combine the lentil salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (15 oz) cans lentils
⅓ cup mayonnaise
3 tbsp ranch dressing
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and trim tomatoes. Slicing from the top down, cut tomatoes into wedges, being careful to not cut completely through to the bottom; sprinkle with salt.
When the flatbreads are done, remove from oven and slice crosswise into 2-inch wide strips.
Divide tomatoes between plates and stuff with lentil salad. Serve with cheesy breadsticks on the side and enjoy!
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 ¼ lb ribeye steak
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil; working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium zucchini squash
1 small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Trim zucchini, then run a vegetable peeler along the length of each zucchini to make ribbons. Place in a large bowl.
Pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Juice lemons into the bowl. Drizzle with oil, then sprinkle with Parmesan and spices. Gently toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ cup Parmesan cheese, shredded
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide steak and salad between plates. Enjoy!
